drafts.title: Saved seat positions restore reliably and quickly
drafts.description: When a driver selects their saved seat profile, the seat returns to the stored position predictably and without manual correction.
drafts.acceptance_criterion: In 20 randomized restore attempts across ignition cycles and door cycles, the seat restores to within 10 mm linear and 1° angular of the saved position in ≥95% of attempts and completes the motion within 3 seconds.
assumptions: Measurement uses standard vehicle fixture and position sensor references available for validation.
Electrical supply is within normal operating range (no low-voltage condition).
uncertainties: Long-term wear or aftermarket seat modifications may degrade restore accuracy.
Some extreme user-configured profiles (very low/high positions) might require slightly longer move times.

drafts.title: Front seats provide adjustable extendable thigh support for tall drivers
drafts.description: Front seat cushion includes an extendable cushion section the user can adjust to increase thigh support for taller occupants.
drafts.acceptance_criterion: Extendable cushion provides at least 80 mm of additional fore-aft support travel with at least three distinct detents; at maximum extension it supports the lower thigh of a 190 cm occupant when the seat is in their normal driving position.
assumptions: 190 cm represents a tall-driver reference for validation measurements.
Measurement method uses anatomical landmark references consistent with industry practice.
uncertainties: Integration with seat heating/ventilation modules could affect cushion thickness and perceived support.
Different trim/seat options may slightly change available extension.

drafts.title: Rear seat knee clearance meets executive-sedan class benchmark
drafts.description: Rear passengers experience competitive legroom compared with main competitors in the executive-sedan segment.
drafts.acceptance_criterion: With front seats set to positions occupied by a 178 cm driver, measured rear knee clearance (distance from front-seat back panel to rear knee point) is ≥360 mm.
assumptions: 178 cm driver reference and 360 mm knee clearance reflect a reasonable class benchmark at successor launch.
Measurement follows a repeatable method using anatomical reference points.
uncertainties: Competitor benchmarks may shift before launch; packaging constraints could limit achievable knee room in certain powertrain variants.

drafts.title: Practical interior storage and trunk power for bottles and coolers
drafts.description: Cup holders accommodate common bottle sizes safely and a trunk power socket enables running a portable cooler without folding seats.
drafts.acceptance_criterion: Cup holders retain bottles up to 90 mm diameter and 320 mm height without tipping during normal vehicle motions; a 12 V power outlet is available in the trunk, accessible without folding seats, and is rated to supply at least 120 W continuous (10 A at nominal 12 V) behind a protective cover.
assumptions: Bottles up to 90 mm diameter represent common consumer bottle sizes in target markets.
Vehicle electrical architecture can provide a 10 A continuous circuit to the trunk in series production variants.
uncertainties: Local regulations or market-specific electrical architecture may limit continuous current availability.
Very large or non-standard bottles may still require custom adapters.

drafts.title: Ambient lighting with expanded color palette and per-zone brightness control
drafts.description: Users can personalize interior ambient lighting with a wide selection of colors and fine-grained brightness per cabin zone.
drafts.acceptance_criterion: System provides at least 64 distinct colors and at least 10 brightness steps, adjustable independently for a minimum of three zones (driver front, passenger front, rear).
assumptions: Perceived distinct colors are based on calibrated color mapping in typical cabin materials and lighting conditions.
Three zones cover primary personalization use cases for passengers.
uncertainties: Perceived color differences may vary with interior trim materials and exterior lighting conditions.
Future software updates could expand palette or zones post-launch.

drafts.title: Door and tailgate access operate reliably in freezing and wet conditions
drafts.description: Users can open doors and the hands-free tailgate reliably in typical winter conditions and after exposure to freezing spray or wet snow.
drafts.acceptance_criterion: Flush door handles and hands-free tailgate open successfully on first user attempt in ≥98% of trials at −10 °C after a 30-minute freezing spray test, and in ≥95% of trials during light snow/wet conditions.
assumptions: Freezing spray test protocol represents realistic freezing-rain scenarios; −10 °C represents severe winter conditions in target markets.
Battery state is within normal operating range during tests.
uncertainties: Extreme ice thickness, physical damage, or aftermarket modifications may still prevent correct operation.
Different weather profiles in specific markets could require additional tuning.
